method: Assembles a Cache-Control response header from explicit directives instead of copying a recipe. The visibility choice emits public, private or nothing; the six checkboxes emit no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate, no-transform and immutable; and the four numeric fields emit max-age, s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate and stale-if-error, each only when a value is present. Every number must be a whole number of seconds with no sign, unit or decimal point, at most 999,999,999, so an empty field means the directive is omitted. Directives are always emitted in one fixed order — public, private, no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate, no-transform, immutable, max-age, s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error — so the same settings always produce the same string, and an empty selection is refused rather than returned as a bare header. The builder reports freshness per audience: the browser figure comes from max-age, the shared-cache figure from s-maxage when present and max-age otherwise, and both are replaced by "not stored" for no-store, by "not stored" for the shared cache when the response is private, and by "revalidated" for no-cache. Combinations that cancel each other are named rather than silently removed: no-store beside any freshness or immutable directive, immutable without a positive max-age, no-cache beside a positive max-age, must-revalidate beside no-cache, proxy-revalidate beside s-maxage, s-maxage on a private response, stale-while-revalidate or stale-if-error without a freshness window, and a max-age above one year, which caches clamp to 31,536,000 seconds. Notes flag heuristic freshness when no max-age is set, the difference between max-age=0 and no-cache, an unstated public or private, and public beside no-store. Freshness lifetimes are shown in human units next to a verdict that classifies the policy as not stored, immutable, revalidated, background-refreshed, fresh or heuristic. The page also renders an nginx add_header line and an Express res.set call carrying the same header. Not modelled: Age, Vary, ETag, Last-Modified, the Expires header, cache key configuration, CDN-specific rules and purges, and any heuristic-freshness estimate beyond naming it. Pure local string assembly: no storage, uploads or network access.
